description: This file defines the AdoNetReminderTable class, which implements the IReminderTable interface for managing reminder data in Orleans using ADO.NET. It includes methods for initializing the table, reading, upserting, and removing reminder entries, and clearing the table for testing purposes.

classes.name: AdoNetReminderTable
classes.description: Implements the IReminderTable interface for managing reminders in Orleans using ADO.NET.
